name: RadioButton

props.name: checked
props.description: Specify whether the `<RadioButton>` is currently checked

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `RadioButton` component

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Specify whether the `<RadioButton>` should be checked by default

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the control is disabled

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Specify whether the label should be hidden, or not

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently invalid

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in an invalid state

props.name: labelPosition
props.description: Provide where label text should be placed NOTE: `top`/`bottom` are deprecated

props.name: labelText
props.description: Provide label text to be read by screen readers when interacting with the control

props.name: name
props.description: Provide a name for the underlying `<input>` node

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Specify whether the RadioButton should be read-only

props.name: required
props.description: `true` to specify if the input is required.

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `RadioButton` component

props.name: warn
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently in warning state

props.name: warnText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in warning state

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon RadioButton rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
